allow_instructions: Allow workspace Write/Edit/Create for normal source files (.dart .cpp .h .js .ts .html .css .json .yaml .md .py) inside SotongWare repos without Run prompts.
Allow safe in-repo Copy-Item / Move-Item / Rename-Item / New-Item when source and destination stay inside allowed SotongWare repository roots.
Allow read-only git inspection such as status, diff, log, show, rev-parse, and branch listing.
Allow git add and git commit for local development completion. Keep git push gated.
Allow Flutter/Dart analyze, test, format, and pub get in the workspace.
Allow npm/npx test, lint, and build scripts in the workspace.
Allow Python pytest and scripts/test_*.py validation scripts.
Allow local cmake/msbuild/dotnet build and test commands that do not deploy.
Allow reading project files and logs needed for validation.
block_instructions: Every production deploy or firebase deploy must go through approval first.
Every git push, force push, reset --hard, or git clean must go through approval first.
Every command that deletes many files, changes credentials/secrets, or restarts Agent services must go through approval first.
Never auto-approve STEP15 site_user_review decisions or STEP18 public production publish.
Never auto-approve overwriting sotongware.com or automation.sotongware.com production sites.
Never auto-approve Write outside allowed SotongWare repository roots.
